items.difficulty_reason: 48 行、谱空间极限上拉层的截面计算：单射用谱空间闭集极限非空引理 + 茎识别 (p_i^{-1}G)_x = (f_{b∘a}^{-1}G)_{p_k(x)}；满射用拟紧性取有限覆盖 + descend-opens 引理沿过渡态射下降 + 由单射得相交一致后 glue。承重计算全在 span 内；3 处跨章 Topology 引理引用均可解析建桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-compute-pullback-to-limit (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3781-3790

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: injectivity of the canonical map via the nonemptiness of limits of closed subsets of spectral spaces and the stalk identification for the pullback sheaf; surjectivity via a finite quasi-compact refinement, the descent of coverings along the limit, and glueing by the injectivity already proved (source lines 3792-3839)
